question: Two pipes A and B together can fill a cistern in 4 hours. Had they been opened separately, then B would have taken 6 hours more than A to fill the cistern. How much time will be taken by A to fill the cistern separately?
solution:
**Given:**

Time taken by A and B together = 4 hours

Time taken by B is 6 hours more than A

**Formula Used:**

If A can fill the cistern in x hours, then B will take (x + 6) hours.

Combined work rate of A and B = 1/4 (since they fill the cistern together in 4 hours)

**Calculation:**

Let time taken by A = x hours

Time taken by B = x + 6 hours
